description:
Filed 2026-08-12 on completing the TwoFluid1d solver core (op-62vf), as a hand-off to whoever writes the six-equation benchmark cases (op-s1a0).

WHAT THE SOLVER OFFERS. crates/tampines/src/multiphase_1d/two_fluid.rs:
  TwoFluid1d::new(pipe, exchange, pressure, temperature, dt) -> Result<Self>
  TwoFluid1d::bubbly(pipe, pressure, temperature, dt)  -- Schiller-Naumann + Ranz-Marshall + spherical, 1 mm
  set_temperature_profile(&[ThermodynamicTemperature])  -- for the Hendrie non-isothermal profile
  set_left_boundary / set_right_boundary (TwoFluidBoundary::{Closed, PrescribedVelocity, ChokedOutlet})
  set_virtual_mass_coefficient / set_initial_void_fraction / set_residual_alpha / set_outer_correctors / set_pressure_under_relaxation
  step() -> Result<TwoFluidReport>
  read-only: pressure, void_fraction, liquid_fraction, vapour_/liquid_density, vapour_/liquid_enthalpy, vapour_/liquid_temperature, saturation_temperature, vapour_/liquid_face_velocity, slip_velocity, mixture_density, inventory, total_enthalpy, outlet_mass_flow

TwoFluidReport carries time, outlet_mass_flow, max/min_void_fraction, max_thermal_nonequilibrium, max_slip, inventory, max_courant, max_volume_residual, outer_correctors_used, outlet_choked, mass_transfer_limited_cells, residual_alpha_floor_events.

READ THESE BEFORE STARTING, both filed 2026-08-12:
1. 'low-void starts refuse -- vapour cannot shed its expansion work'. Edwards-O'Brien starts 57 K SUBCOOLED, which is exactly the regime that refuses after 10-15 steps. A two-fluid Edwards case is BLOCKED on that, not merely unwritten. Do not work around it by tuning the initial void fraction until it runs -- that is choosing a model parameter to get a benchmark to pass.
2. 'no Dirichlet-pressure boundary'. There is no ReservoirInlet or PressureOutlet, so a Marviken-style vessel discharge has no inlet boundary to use.

WHAT IS OBLIGATORY IF A CASE IS WRITTEN, per crates/tampines/docs/six-equation-regularisation.md section 9.5:
  - a grid-refinement study, with the observed order -- the system is NOT known to be well posed, so refinement may not improve the answer, and reporting a single-mesh number would be misleading;
  - a sensitivity of the headline result to C_vm over at least [0, 0.5]. two_fluid_tests::the_answer_moves_with_c_vm_and_the_sensitivity_is_reported shows how, and measured on the demonstrator case: 8.4 % spread in max |T_g - T_l|, 1.1 % in slip, 0.16 % in outlet mass flow;
  - the same for the initial void fraction, which is a model parameter with no measured provenance.

A WORKING STARTING POINT EXISTS: two_fluid_tests::a_two_phase_blowdown_marches_without_refusing runs the Edwards geometry from a SATURATED two-phase state and completes -- 667 steps at 8 cells, and 10002 steps (full 300 ms) at 24 cells, reaching 19.3 K of thermal non-equilibrium and 1.46 m/s of slip. That is not Edwards (wrong initial condition) but it is the harness shape a case would reuse.
title: tampines: Edwards-O'Brien and Marviken two-fluid (6-eqn) cases -- API is ready, read the two blocker beads first

description: DEFERRED / not started. New workspace crate: pure-Rust translation of PFLOTRAN (LGPL, GPL-3.0-compatible; DOE Fortran+PETSc massively-parallel subsurface flow & reactive-transport simulator). Conventions: enum dispatch for flow modes/solvers/EOS (no trait objects), uom-typed API, pure-Rust solver (no PETSc FFI, no MPI in v1), Android-buildable. NAMING PROVISIONAL: outram-park-fork-pflotran — maintainer must confirm before scaffolding. Plan produced 2026-07-16.
